title: Metaverse as answer to the Fermi paradox

tellings.quote: So, as soon as I heard about the metaverse being announced, Yes. I realized that it may be a solution to Enrico Fermi's paradox.

plain: A Harvard researcher, Avi Loeb, tells podcast host Jesse Michels in early 2022 that when he heard the metaverse announced in 2021, meaning a plan for shared online virtual worlds, he realised it might solve the Fermi paradox. That paradox, named after the physicist Enrico Fermi, asks why we see no sign of other civilisations if the universe should be full of them, so if Loeb is right, the idea would offer a reason why we have heard from no one.
